title: [2.7.2-dev] Graph shows temporary target of 0 for a few minutes
symptom: While an eating soon temporary target of 80 was set, the target was changed to 0 for a few minutes. The user could not find anything in the logs but suspected a glitch.
cause: The developer MilosKozak stated that this is caused by wrong NS synchronization.
fix: The developer suggested to turn on NS upload only, but the user reported that they had already turned on 'NS upload only' at the time this happened.
evidence_quote: this is caused by worng NS synchronization. turn on NS upload only
